5401.title: Session restoration rejects explicitly authorized ACP requests
5401.rootCauseOneLine: The active-turn guard cancels valid load-time permission requests before the full-access policy is evaluated.
5401.proposedFix: Preserve stop/cancel guards and fail-closed defaults; explicitly admit a matching restoring-session permission request under full access before rejecting other out-of-turn requests. Validate session identity against the restoring session, not the not-yet-assigned providerThreadId. Decide restricted-mode restoration interaction ownership separately.
5401.caveats: Synthetic ACP wire fixture on Linux; no real Muse/macOS run, adapter approval-projection validation, downstream pending-approval error reproduction, or fork-workaround verification. No production fix: changing permission handling is excluded by the simple-fix rule.
